final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT pt.TrackId AS playlist_track_id, mt.Name AS media_type_name, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY pt.TrackId, mt.Name), total AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts) SELECT gc.media_type_name, SUM(gc.group_count) AS total_group_count, AVG(1.0 * gc.group_count / total.total_count) AS average_count_share FROM group_counts AS gc JOIN total ON total.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gc.media_type_name
